entities.name: YihG (P32129)
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to the 310-residue query; E-value 2.72e-229 with 100% identity and 100% coverage.
Annotated as a single-pass inner-membrane protein of Escherichia coli.
Catalyzes 1-acylglycerol-3-phosphate O-acyltransferase activity, EC 2.3.1.51, in phospholipid biosynthesis.
Introduces an acyl group, including cis-vaccenoyl (18:1), at the sn-2 position of phospholipid precursors.

entities.name: Query membrane acyltransferase
observations: Length 310 aa; predicted molecular weight 36.3 kDa; theoretical pI 9.66.
N-terminal region is strongly hydrophobic and supports membrane anchoring.
Contains Pfam Acyltransferase domain PF01553 at residues 84–214.
Sequence-derived and homology evidence support a phospholipid acyltransferase rather than a receptor or transporter.

entities.name: 1-acyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate acylation
observations: Mapped to Rhea RHEA:19709 and associated with EC 2.3.1.51.

entities.name: Phospholipid metabolism
observations: YihG functions in bacterial membrane phospholipid biosynthesis.
